Silent corruption risk: native_menu_entry.hpp Hub hook. DOTO's Iggy external-call hub (D2 0x34800 -> 0x35630; the 12-byte prologue pin still passes) takes a 4th argument (r9d -> ebp; 'cmp ebp,1' selects call 0x2bb80 vs 0x2c1b0). hub_hook declares 3 params and calls hub_original_(self,player,call), so r9 is garbage on every Iggy external call. Needs a source change: Hub=unsigned long long(__fastcall*)(void*,void*,void*,unsigned long long) and hub_hook(...,unsigned long long arg4) forwarding arg4, or do not install NativeMenuEntry on DOTO. It is hooked even though no movie patch can match (install = hub && load).

Needs new AS3 RE of DOTO's movies, not regeneration.
